policy: Every Clawix visible surface and agent-generated UI surface must satisfy Constitution IX.8 accessibility axes or declare an explicit expiring gap. Accessibility governance does not grant visual, copy, layout, or motion authority.

requiredAxes.summary: Interactive controls, groups, status, errors, and generated content expose coherent assistive-technology semantics.
Primary and recurring actions are reachable from keyboard alone.
Traversal order follows visual reading order and modal focus is restored safely.
externalEvidence: screen reader or keyboard traversal run

requiredAxes.summary: The focused element remains visible and has a clear focus state.
Text, controls, selected states, errors, and generated UI respect platform accessibility contrast settings.
Motion respects platform reduce-motion preferences and time-based effects have a non-motion path.
Text can scale without clipping, overlap, inaccessible truncation, or loss of action reachability.
Images, icons, controls, generated media, and composite controls provide labels or are hidden when decorative.
Timed interactions, transient states, auto-dismiss UI, and generated flows provide a non-timed alternative.
SDK, custom, generated, and agent-authored UI inherits the same accessibility contract before completion.
